test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Her parents asked her if the match proposed by them would be acceptable to her.

options.text: Her parents said to her, “Will the match proposed by us be acceptable to you?”
Her parents said to her, “Was the match proposed by them acceptable to her?”
Her parents said her, “Would the match proposed by them be acceptable to her?”
Her parents said her, “Will the match proposed by us be acceptable to you?”

solution:
​The correct answer is **'****Her parents said to her, “Will the match proposed by us be acceptable to you?”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To change from *indirect to direct speech*, we use the following steps - 

 
 
• The reporting verb asked is changed to **said to.**
 
• Put a comma (,) after 'Her parents said to her...'
 
• Insert inverted commas ("...") to mark the statement part of the direct speech.
 
• The modal verb if changes to will to make it an interrogative sentence. 
 
• Capitalize the first word of the statement. (will)
 
 
 
• When we follow the above steps, we get the following sentence - Her parents said to her, “Will the match proposed by us be acceptable to you?”
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.
